method: Six independently created level-one classes in test_catalog_campaign.started authored integration town, campaign seeds17..22. Sixty attempted public Session operations per class, controller Random(418+class_index). Manufacture candidates require outputs; empty choices fall back to wait(1). No XP, resources or state injected after genesis. Every rejected ValueError must leave serialized Session and RNG unchanged. Final schema31 JSON roundtrip/replay and RNG checked. No model/network calls.
limitations: Short synthetic exploration/resource sequences, not manual play, a level20 proof for six classes, full combat progression or a balance study. Refusals from unavailable local resources/class restrictions are expected.
